risks.title: NexusScoreWidget displays fabricated 72/100 threat score globally
risks.impact: Players misled by fake risk metric; no methodology, no provenance, simulates real-time updates
risks.mitigation: Remove widget globally; replace with evidence-backed grade component on relevant pages only

risks.title: GamingSecurityCheckup saves scores to Convex without enforced consent
risks.impact: Personal assessment data stored with userId linkage; consentId optional in mutation; no consent UI
risks.mitigation: Make anonymous default; require explicit consent UI before any Convex write; add rate limiting

risks.title: Broken navigation links throughout site (7+ routes)
risks.impact: Users hit 404s on promised features (Grades, Safety, Threats, Platforms, Recovery, Methodology); SEO damage
risks.evidence: Navbar.tsx:70-77, FooterRedesigned.tsx:12-18, Homepage.tsx:150 reference non-existent routes
risks.mitigation: Implement missing routes or remove/replace links; add redirect map

risks.title: About page positions as professional publication, not player-safety service
risks.impact: Confuses player conversion; partnerships and search intent misaligned; claims unverified credentials
risks.mitigation: Rewrite About for player-first: prevent, check, recover, learn; qualify/remove unverified claims

risks.title: Privacy policy may not match actual data processing
risks.impact: GDPR/CCPA/ODPC non-compliance risk; users misled about data practices; no consent gating verified
risks.evidence: src/pages/Privacy.tsx renders policy but research extraction failed; CookieConsent exists but GA4/Ads gating unverified
risks.mitigation: Audit actual network requests vs policy claims; implement consent gating; add DPIA for Kenya/children

risks.title: No threat model or ASVS baseline for application security
risks.impact: Unknown attack surface; no systematic control coverage; cannot claim 'secure platform'
risks.evidence: No threat-model.md, no asvs-mapping.json; Convex mutations lack rate limiting; no CSP
risks.mitigation: Create threat model (T08); map ASVS L2 controls; implement CSP report-only (T11)

risks.title: Community threat reports lack moderation pipeline and abuse controls
risks.impact: Unverified reports could defame; no spam/duplicate detection; no reporter safety; no appeals
risks.evidence: convex/schema.ts:1160-1189 (communityThreatReports table), no moderation UI found
risks.mitigation: Build moderation queue, anti-spam, appeals, escalation procedures before enabling submissions

risks.title: SteamScanner username input visible (disabled) — implies collection
risks.impact: Users may believe username is collected/used; contradicts 'anonymous' claim
risks.mitigation: Remove username input entirely; strengthen 'no username collected' messaging

risks.title: GamingSecurityCheckup uses 'Fort Knox/Exposed' personal risk tiers
risks.impact: Tier labels imply probability of compromise; not 'protection readiness'; 'Exposed' = fear language
risks.mitigation: Replace with 'protection readiness' bands (Excellent/Good/Fair/Needs Work); higher = more protective answers

risks.title: No rate limiting on Convex mutations (saveSecurityScore, etc.)
risks.impact: Abuse potential: score stuffing, consent bypass, storage exhaustion
risks.mitigation: Add per-session/IP rate limits with configurable budgets; privacy-aware logs

risks.title: No CSP headers — XSS risk from rich text/embeds
risks.impact: Stored/reflected/DOM XSS via content, comments, TipTap editor, external embeds
risks.evidence: vite.config.ts, vercel.json — no CSP; TipTap editor used; community content rendered
risks.mitigation: Deploy CSP report-only; eliminate unsafe-inline; add nonces/hashes; frame-ancestors

risks.title: No automated DSAR (access/deletion) system
risks.impact: Cannot fulfill GDPR/CCPA/ODPC rights requests within 30 days; manual only
risks.evidence: Privacy policy claims 30-day response; no code for automated deletion
risks.mitigation: Build DSAR endpoint with verification; automated Convex deletion across tables

risks.title: Clerk auth keys in browser bundle; no separate admin surface
risks.impact: Public key exposure normal for Clerk; but no admin/privileged role separation observed
risks.mitigation: Verify Clerk configuration (phishing-resistant auth for admins); separate admin routes

risks.title: Adsterra popunder/ads may conflict with security-tool trust
risks.impact: Popunders on security checkup pages undermine credibility; AdScriptInitializer global
risks.mitigation: Isolate ads from security-tool flows; disable on /tools/* routes

risks.title: East Africa regional content lacks validated provider contacts
risks.impact: SIM-swap/M-Pesa guidance may have stale/incorrect escalation contacts
risks.evidence: Plan G09, S15/S16 (ODPC guidance); upsertEastAfricaGuide.ts exists
risks.mitigation: Verify telco/payment contacts from official sources before publishing; local reviewer sign-off
